```js
let counter = 0;

export async function listTools() {
  return [{
    name: 'ticket_create',
    description: 'Create a support ticket',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        title: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, description: 'Ticket title' },
        description: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, description: 'Ticket description' },
        priority: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'normal', 'high'], default: 'normal' }
      },
      required: ['title', 'description'],
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }];
}

const PRIORITIES = ['low', 'normal', 'high'];

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'ticket_create') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  
  // Validate arguments
  if (!args || typeof args !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments');
  }
  
  const allowedKeys = new Set(['title', 'description', 'priority']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowedKeys.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown field: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  
  const { title, description } = args;
  
  if (typeof title !== 'string' || title.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('title must be a non-empty string');
  }
  if (typeof description !== 'string' || description.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('description must be a non-empty string');
  }
  
  let priority = args.priority;
  if (priority === undefined) {
    priority = 'normal';
  } else if (!PRIORITIES.includes(priority)) {
    throw new Error(`priority must be one of ${PRIORITIES.join(', ')}`);
  }
  
  counter += 1;
  const id = `t${counter}`;
  return {
    content: [{
      type: 'text',
      text: `Created ticket ${id} [${priority}]: ${title}`
    }]
  };
}
```
